findings.issue: The ABI encoding loop over facetCuts prints as 'while True' whose exit branch, at the top of the body, contains the rest of the function (encoding of initAddress/initCalldata, the external call and 'stop'), so the loop bound and the code after the loop are hard to see.
findings.rule: If a 'while True' body starts with 'if c: E' where E never falls through (ends in stop/return/revert), restructure as 'while not c: <rest of body>' followed by E (same rule as c00442's while True).

findings.rule: Mask(32, 224, x) is the left-aligned 4-byte value: print bytes4(x) (or Mask(32, 224, x) == x as 'x == bytes4(x)').

notes: No explicit loop in the source of this contract and the internal functions it reaches. All 37 whiles are implicit ABI loops: decoding and re-encoding of DiamondCutData (nested FacetCut[] and bytes4[] arrays, P7) and of other calldata arrays forwarded to the bridgehub/diamond proxies; the bytes members are copy lines. Owner/admin checks, protocol-version storage, upgrade-cut hashes and events match the source by reading.
summary: Faithful; there are no source loops, and the many implicit ABI loops for diamond cuts are correct but often printed as 'while True' with the rest of the function inside the exit branch.
